description.value: Okanagan Spirits is Western Canada's original craft distillery, founded in 2004 and crafting internationally awarded spirits from 100% BC grain and fruit. The Kelowna location on Bernard Avenue features a tasting room, cocktail lounge, and patio open to drop-in visitors without a reservation. In 2025 the distillery swept the podium at the World Spirits Awards in Germany, earning the World-Class Distillery designation alongside 11 Gold and 5 Silver medals.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 95m; lockers (secure) at 97m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Kelowna location at 267 Bernard Avenue with phone 1-778-484-5174, matching OSM tags exactly. The contact page describes the Kelowna site as a 'DISTILLERY | TASTING ROOM | COCKTAIL LOUNGE & PATIO', confirming it is an active, publicly accessible hospitality venue. No website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities, so those are marked null per the evidence-only rule.

Drop-in tastings require no reservation, making it accessible for touring cyclists.
